Job Details: 
 
 
 Job Description: 
Join us as a Circuits Research Engineer/Scientist and be at the forefront of innovation in analog, mixed-signal, and digital circuit technologies. In this role, you will play a critical part in driving the research and development of next-generation Power Delivery IPs that deliver industry-leading performance (efficiency, power density, bandwidth) in advanced process technology nodes. You will contribute to the creation of cutting-edge intellectual property (IP) and features that will shape the future of Intel's future AI and Datacenter Products, enabling higher Perf/Watt and overall value. Your work will directly influence Intel's product roadmap, collaborate across industry and academia, and position Intel as a leader in the semiconductor industry's future innovation.

Key Responsibilities 
- Develop, implement, and execute scientific research projects focused on advancing analog, mixed-signal, and digital circuit techniques to develop innovative power delivery IPs 
- Design and enable new IPs and features to enhance Intel's product offerings. 
- Conduct circuit analysis and simulation and engage in design verification, testing, and debugging of fabricated circuits. 
- Research and propose innovative techniques to achieve superior form-factor, higher input voltage, higher efficiency, and ability to handle fast load transients. 
- Partner with engineering design teams to define product requirements and assess the feasibility of adopting new technologies. 
- Study industry trends, conduct competitive analyses of topologies, and develop proof-of-concepts or prototypes such as test chips. 
- Collaborate with academic institutions, industry partners, and internal technical teams to address complex challenges and find innovative solutions. 
- Disseminate research findings through scientific publications, patents, presentations, and outreach efforts to enhance Intel's reputation as a thought leader in circuit design and advanced technologies. 
 
 Qualifications: 
 Minimum Qualifications 
- PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, with specialization in power delivery. 
- Proficiency in power delivery (Switched Capacitors, Inductor Buck, Linear, and Hybrid topologies) circuits with ability to perform detailed design, analysis, and simulation tools. 
- Strong expertise in analog electronics, semiconductor device physics, and electrical fundamentals. 
- Hands-on experience with circuit testing, signal and power integrity, and analog behavior modeling. 

Preferred Qualifications 
- Demonstrated ability to solve complex problems and develop innovative power delivery circuit techniques. 
- Strong communication and collaboration skills to effectively work across cross-functional teams and external partnerships. 
- Contributions to scientific publications, patents, or industry collaborations showcasing research leadership and innovation. 

If you are passionate about cutting-edge research and want to be part of a team that is shaping the future of technology, we encourage you to apply today and bring your expertise to Intel.

College Grad

 We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. It consists of competitive pay, stock bonuses, and benefit programs which include health, retirement, and vacation. Find out more about the benefits of working at Intel .
